name: Shuuya
source:
One of the four people with the special abilities from the Setou Underground Science Institution, he is good at viability. It seems like he has some unfinished business with one of his military mates...

[Roughly translated from [url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]the official site[/url].]
